title: Q3 Tranche-Based Roadmap & OKR Map for Private/VPC Enterprise Deliverables
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a tranche-based quarterly roadmap that maps discrete Private/VPC/on-prem deliverables to measurable OKRs, risk gates, and rollout windows so we can onboard three regulated enterprise customers by EOY with predictable SLAs and upgrade paths. Scope includes: RBAC & tenant isolation improvements, private control-plane upgrades, KMS/HSM integrations, upgrade/compatibility automation, and entitlements & billing flows for reserved capacity. This ticket captures planning artifacts, cross-functional owners, milestone acceptance criteria, and the go/no-go gating cadence for each tranche.
milestones: Tranche A (GA readiness for regulated pilots): complete RBAC v2 + audit log schema, KMS integration alpha, private-control plane telemetry — target: 2025-07-18
Tranche B (Pilot rollouts & capacity): automated upgrade driver, reserved capacity billing MVP, per-tenant observability + SLO dashboards — target: 2025-08-22
Tranche C (Scale & hardened upgrade): canary automation, cross-region failover for private clusters, compliance packaging + SOC/ISO artifacts — target: 2025-09-19
okrs: OKR-1: Reduce mean time to onboard a regulated customer to private deployment from 8 weeks to <=3 weeks (KPI: onboarding time)
OKR-2: Achieve 99.95% uptime SLA for Dedicated/Private customers on baseline workloads (KPI: availability), measured across pilot customers
OKR-3: Lower per-token serving unit cost for private deployments by 18% via batching/quantization recommendations (KPI: cost per 1k tokens)
OKR-4: Deliver audit-ready compliance artifacts for 2 regulated industries (finance, healthcare) by end of tranche C
acceptance_criteria: RBAC v2 implemented with role templates and test coverage; sample tenant demonstrating isolation
KMS flow documented and validated end-to-end with one cloud KMS provider and HSM sign-off checklist
Automated upgrade runbook exercised in staging with zero customer-data downtime for a +2 minor version change
Per-tenant SLO dashboard shows latency, error rate, and cost-by-route signals; alerts tied to rollback playbook
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: KMS/HSM vendor integration delays — Mitigation: parallel adapter work and early vendor contract templates
Risk: Upgrade automation causes unexpected performance regressions — Mitigation: staged canary with traffic shaping and automatic fallback to previous model variant
Risk: Compliance documentation lag — Mitigation: allocate technical writer and schedule SOC artifact reviews with legal in tranche B
communication_plan: Weekly cross-functional roadmap sync (PM, Eng, Design, Security) — Wednesdays 10:00
Biweekly exec checkpoint with Sales and CS to align customer onboarding expectations
Confluence: Roadmap & onboarding checklist page linked in ticket for all artifacts
measurement_and_signALS: Onboarding lead time (days) tracked per-customer in postmortem dashboard
SLO compliance percentage per tenant (latency P95, error rate) — automated checks pre/post rollout
Cost delta vs baseline for representative workloads after applying Optimize recommendations
